title: Le Nozze di Giustizia. Interactions between Artificial Intelligence, Law, Logic, Language and Computation with some case studies in Traffic Regulations and Health Care.
reasoning: The paper contains a dedicated section (2.3) discussing the historical and philosophical approaches of Christianity and Islam toward the scientific method and how this relates to the current acceptance of AI. It also explores 'Good Governance' and 'Good Administration' as ethical/moral frameworks for public administration and touches on human values like compassion and humanity.
